summary.text: Rebecca Holcombe, a Democrat from Norwich, has represented Windsor-Orange-2 in the Vermont House of Representatives since 2023.
She sits on the House Committee on Ways and Means and previously served as Vermont's Secretary of Education.

paragraphs.text: Holcombe lived in Afghanistan, Pakistan, the Fiji Islands, Sudan and China before returning with her family to Vermont, according to her House biography.
She worked in outdoor education as an EMT, as a middle and high school teacher, a school principal and a district leader, and as Vermont's Secretary of Education.

She founded the Greenway Institute, a National Science Foundation-funded startup for students from underrepresented backgrounds in sustainable engineering, and holds a master's degree in business administration and a doctorate in administration, policy and leadership.
She serves on the board of Equal Access to Broadband and chaired the Norwich Child Care Committee.
